explanation: Matches Montgomery–Pokrovskiy–Sudakov (arXiv 2001.02665) Theorem 1.2: for every sufficiently large n, K_{2n+1} decomposes into copies of any tree with n edges. The threshold on n is uniform over trees, as in the paper. Pairwise-disjoint edge sets with supremum ⊤ is a partition of the edges into images of T under vertex embeddings, and exactly 2n+1 copies is what the edge count forces. Quantifying over `V : Type` loses nothing, since any tree is isomorphic to one on a type in universe 0. Faithful.
